28. If $\angle B = 90^\circ$, $AB = 5\text{ cm}$, $BC = 12\text{ cm}$ of $\triangle ABC$
1) Find the length of $AC$.
2) If $\angle C = \theta$, find the value of $\sin \theta + \cos \theta$.
3) Using stem show that, $\sec^2 A + \csc^2 A = \sec^2 A \cdot \csc^2 A$

29. In accordance of the given figure
1) what is the measurement of $AC$?
2) Find the value of $\tan A + \tan C$.
3) Find the values of $x$ and $y$.

30. $\sin \theta = p$, $\cos \theta = q$, $\tan \theta = r$, where $\theta$ is an acute angle.
1) If $r = \sqrt{(3)^{-1}}$, find the value of $\theta$.
2) If $p + q = \sqrt{2}$, prove that $\theta = 45^\circ$.
3) If $7p^2 + 3q^2 = 4$, show that, $\tan \theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}$.
31. $ABC$ is a right-angled triangle whose $\angle B = \text{one right-angle}$ and $AB = BC$. Prove that, $\frac{BC\cos C - AC\cos B}{BC\cos B - AC\cos A} + \cos C = 0$
32. $ABC$ is a right-angled triangle whose $\angle B = \text{one right-angle}$ and $\cot A + \cot B = 2\cot C$. Prove that, $AC^2 + BC^2 = 2AB^2$.
